spec.description:
Higgins Polyester Batts (Ceiling and Wall Batts) are
Australian-made thermal and acoustic insulation batts manufactured in Queensland
from 100% thermally bonded polyester fiber with up to 85% recycled PET.
Completely free from formaldehyde, chemical binders, and resins, they are soft
to touch, non-toxic, and non-allergenic, making them safe for asthma sufferers
and comfortable to install without protective clothing. Engineered with high
tensile resiliency, they will not sag, slump, or break down over the life of the
building, providing long-term thermal resistance from R1.5 to R5.0.
features:
100% thermally bonded polyester fiber containing up to 85%
recycled PET

Completely itch-free, non-toxic, non-allergenic, and safe to
handle without PPE

Free from formaldehyde, chemical binders, phenol, and
ammonia
Zero Ozone Depleting Potential (ODP) and low VOC emissions

High
tensile strength and fiber resiliency prevents slumping or sagging over time
Naturally hydrophobic and quick drying; largely unaffected by moisture
Tested to AS/NZS 1530.3 for fire safety

Approved by Asthma Foundations
Australia for low-allergen buildings

Thermal ratings from R1.5 to R2.5 for
walls and R2.0 to R5.0 for ceilings

Backed by a lifetime product performance
guarantee

install:
Turn off electrical power at the main switchboard before entering
ceilings or touching wall cavities

Select batt width (430mm or 580mm) to
match stud or joist centers (450mm or 600mm)

In ceilings, lay batts flat
between ceiling joists ensuring complete coverage over plasterboard with zero
gaps

In walls, friction-fit batts firmly between studs ensuring batts butt
tightly against top and bottom plates

Maintain minimum 50mm clearance around
non-IC rated recessed downlights and heat sources per AS 3999

Maintain a 20mm
clearance between roof sarking and ceiling batts at roof eaves

Tear batts
across the width by hand or trim with a sharp serrated knife if custom sizing is
needed
selection_checklist:
Confirm application (ceiling space vs
external or internal wall)

Select target R-value (R2.0/R2.5 in walls; R3.5 to
R5.0 in ceilings) to meet NCC climate zone requirements

Measure framing
spacing (430mm for 450mm centers; 580mm for 600mm centers)

Check wall stud
depth (75mm for 70mm studs; 90mm for 90mm studs)

Verify preference for
itch-free, zero-formaldehyde polyester insulation
limitations:
Do not compress batts significantly into cavities narrower
than nominal thickness

Not designed for exposed decorative finishes; must be
enclosed behind plasterboard or linings

Maintain mandatory clearances from
non-IC rated electrical fixtures
spec.warranty:
Lifetime performance guarantee
backed by Higgins Insulation

retrieval.rag_summary:
Higgins Insulation Higgins Polyester Batts are Australian-made,
itch-free thermal and acoustic insulation batts manufactured from 100% polyester
fiber containing up to 85% recycled PET bottles. Available in ceiling ratings
from R2.0 to R5.0 and wall ratings from R1.5 to R2.5 (widths 430mm and 580mm),
they fit standard framing without slumping, packing down, or deteriorating over
time. Completely free of chemical binders, resins, and formaldehyde, they are
non-allergenic, Sensitive Choice friendly, and tested to AS/NZS 1530.3 fire
safety standards.
